text: Great storage!. Wonderful to store the tree in after the holiday!

product_metadata.title: Zober Large Christmas Tree Storage Bag - Fits Up to 9 ft Tall Holiday Artificial Disassembled Trees with Durable Reinforced Handles & Dual Zipper - Waterproof Material Protects from Dust and Moisture (Gray)
features: Protect and secure: Xmas tree bags protect Christmas trees from damage, dust, and moisture so it’s always ready to show off. Dimensions 65” x 15” x 30”
Moisture-Resistant: this artificial tree storage bags made from waterproof polyethylene plastic to protect your tree from water damage.
Easy carry: 3 stitch-reinforced handles (2 on the top and 1 on the side) make getting your storage bag for christmas tree between storage and living room hassle-free.

Simple Identification: Festive, bright red holiday storage bag stands out in storage helping you to easily locate your artificial Christmas tree storage box and an attached card slot lets you know exactly what’s inside the storage container for Christmas tree.
Easy Access: Two way/dual zipper opens the holiday storage bag widely for uncomplicated placement and removal; no assembly required just unfold, and insert your tree for great tree bag storage.
